text:
Priya (CS Lead): Quick sync re: Meridian Health onboarding. Contract SLOs: 99.9% monthly uptime, generation p95 <250ms, embeddings p95 <120ms. Need: 1) exact measurement window (UTC vs customer local) 2) public query definitions 3) credits calc we can share. Who's on deck?

Tom (CS Ops): I can own the monthly report automation + emailed artifact. Proposal: use UTC month windows to keep billing consistent across regions. Any objections?

Zoe (Account Exec): Customer ops asked for billing month aligned to their local timezone (PST). Can we add a note in the report that metrics use UTC windows and provide a localised view on request? That might keep the pipeline simple.

Ravi (SRE): UTC windows are simpler. If Meridian needs PST-aligned slices for legal billing we'll provide an alternative export; it will add a 24h reconciliation job. Also: sampling on high-volume customers can bias p95 unless we export raw histograms. Recommend exporting raw histogram buckets per model_tag.

Priya (CS Lead): OK UTC by default; PST export on request. Document that in the onboarding pack. Tom, can you include both in the FAQ?

Tom (CS Ops): Yep. Drafting queries now. For uptime I use the aggregated health_check metric. Example SQL: 
```
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS uptime_pct
FROM service_checks
WHERE service='hosted-api' AND customer_id='meridian' AND ts >= :start AND ts < :end;
```
For p95 latency (histogram approach):
```
SELECT histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_ms_bucket[5m])))
FROM metrics
WHERE customer_id='meridian' AND model_tag IN (:models)
```
These will be parameterized by model_tag and variant.

Zoe (Account Exec): Nice. Customer asked for per-model rows in the one-pager plus an "impact" column if we missed SLOs (credits estimate).

SLO Bot: Scheduled report job created -> job_id: SLO-RUN-235987 (runs monthly at 00:10 UTC on day 1).

Tom (CS Ops): Credits calc (per contract): monthly_credit = floor(monthly_fee * credit_pct) where credit_pct = max(0, (SLO_threshold - measured_uptime) / SLO_threshold). Example: Measured uptime 99.4% -> credit_pct = (99.9-99.4)/99.9 = 0.005005 -> credit = monthly_fee * 0.005 (rounded to nearest dollar). I'll publish a calculator sheet that accepts monthly_fee and measured_uptime and outputs line items.

Ravi (SRE): Two caveats: (1) For latency-based credits the contract is p95 across model_tag set; ensure model variants are grouped correctly. (2) If a partial outage affects a subset of requests (e.g., embeddings only), credits should be prorated by affected request volume. Need volume data.

Priya (CS Lead): Good call. Let's include token/request volume and model-slice in the report so the customer can see granularity. Tom, include a small CSV sample header in the report:
```
month,customer_id,model_tag,variant,uptime_pct,p95_latency_ms,request_count,monthly_fee,credit_amount
```

Zoe (Account Exec): I'll prepare the customer-facing one-pager template. Please add a short incident timeline section (3 bullets) and a callout if credits were applied.

Tom (CS Ops): Action list: (A) publish canonical queries + example CSV -> owner: Tom (due: Fri 2359877100) (B) credits calc sheet + sample numbers -> owner: Tom (due: Fri) (C) sampling/raw histogram export doc -> owner: Ravi (due: Wed) (D) one-pager + email template -> owner: Zoe (due: Thu).

eng-runtime: Quick note on buckets: ensure histogram buckets include high-tail buckets (500ms, 1s, 2s). Also annotate model quantization and sequence-length distribution for the month to explain p95 shifts.

Priya (CS Lead): Thanks — that'll help the renewal conversation. If we see two consecutive months where measured p95 > target, mark renewal risk and schedule a targeted tech review with the customer.

SLO Bot: Monthly report completed for 2024-02 -> uploaded to onboarding/meridian/slo_reports/2024-02.csv

Tom (CS Ops): I'll post the draft queries and the calculator link in the onboarding folder and @Zoe when ready. Ping me if you want PST-aligned windows for their procurement team.

Zoe (Account Exec): Please cc me when first automated email goes out so I can confirm wording. :+1:

Priya (CS Lead): Great work team. I'll collate final artifacts into the shared Meridian packet and mark this ready for the kickoff.

(END)
